name: Camping 101: Cooking

angles.text: As a cook, you learn to kindle the campfire at the heart of a campsite and prepare food for the wilds.
As a Horde traveler in Mulgore, you begin your survival training in Bloodhoof Village, where tauren craftsmen and cooks can guide you.

faq.answer: Cooking teaches you to kindle a campfire and establish a campsite in the wilderness.
Pyall Silentstride teaches cooking in Bloodhoof Village, Mulgore. He shows novice adventurers how to cook and build basic campfires.
Cooking teaches you to kindle a campfire, the practical heart of a campsite, and prepare meals.
faq.q: Why is cooking necessary to learn camping?

faq.answer: As your cooking skill improves, you learn to build larger fires for more substantial campsites.
faq.q: Can you make bigger campfires as your skill improves?

faq.answer: Other crafts can provide furnishings for your campsite. You can make them if you have learned those crafts.
faq.q: How do you furnish a campsite?

faq.answer: Once cooking has taught you to kindle a campfire, you can establish a simple camp in the open wilderness wherever you travel.
faq.q: Where can you set up a camp?

sections.body: When night falls, a campfire gives you a place to return to. Across Kalimdor, basic cooking teaches you to build a fire in the wild. It also shows you how to prepare nourishing meals from hunted game, making cooking part of surviving outdoors.
sections.title: The Hearth of the Wild

sections.body: In Bloodhoof Village, Mulgore, Pyall Silentstride teaches you the basics of cooking. With that training, you can kindle a campfire and pitch a simple camp in the wilderness. As your cooking skill grows, you learn to build larger fires. Other crafts can furnish your outpost.
sections.title: Building the Camp

summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Pyall Silentstride begins your lessons in cooking and campfires. Across Kalimdor, those skills help you make a campsite and prepare meals from hunted game.
